name: flex-status
description: Responsive status band above the prompt: folds onto more rows instead of cutting info when the terminal narrows; every segment can be moved, hidden or restyled

showModel.title: Show Model
showModel.description: Draw the Model segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

showEffort.title: Show Effort
showEffort.description: Draw the Effort segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

showAccount.title: Show Account
showAccount.description: Draw the Account segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

showFolder.title: Show Folder
showFolder.description: Draw the Folder segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

showGit.title: Show Git branch
showGit.description: Draw the Git branch segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

showTtl.title: Show Cache countdown
showTtl.description: Draw the Cache countdown segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

show5h.title: Show 5h limit
show5h.description: Draw the 5h limit segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

show7d.title: Show 7d limit
show7d.description: Draw the 7d limit segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

showCache.title: Show Cache hit ratio
showCache.description: Draw the Cache hit ratio segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

showSession.title: Show Session time
showSession.description: Draw the Session time segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

showClock.title: Show Clock
showClock.description: Draw the Clock segment (it must also be listed in left/right).

bar.title: Context bar
bar.description: Draw the bar that runs up to the auto-compact point.

folderDepth.title: Folder depth
folderDepth.description: How many path parts the folder segment shows.

gitCounts.title: Git change counts
gitCounts.description: Show the ?untracked and !changed counts after the branch.

limitReset.title: Limit reset time
limitReset.description: Show the reset time after the 5h and 7d percentages.

cacheDecimals.title: Cache hit decimals
cacheDecimals.description: Decimals in the cache hit ratio.

autoCompact.title: Compact before cache expires
autoCompact.description: Run /compact shortly before the prompt cache expires, while the context is still a cheap cache read.

compactLead.title: Compact lead (seconds)
compactLead.description: How many seconds before the cache expires the compact starts.

compactMinTokens.title: Compact minimum context
compactMinTokens.description: Skip the auto-compact while the context is smaller than this many tokens.

left.title: Left segments
left.description: Advanced: ids in order, "," joins within a group, "|" starts a new group. Ids: model, effort, account, folder, git, ttl, 5h, 7d, cache, session, clock. The toggles below hide on top of this.

segments.title: Per-segment options (JSON, advanced)
segments.description: Overrides the pickers above for one segment, and adds icon ("" drops it) and color: {"git":{"icon":""},"model":{"color":"#ff8800"},"folder":{"depth":2}}. Knobs: folder depth, git counts, 5h/7d reset, cache decimals, clock hour12/seconds.
